name: Pro Log Explorer
description: Streaming log explorer for 100k+ lines: virtualised live tail with follow/pause, ANSI colours, level facets with counts, regex search highlighting, brushable histogram, JSON field expansion and permalinks.

props.name: logs
props.description: Append-only buffer, oldest first: { id, timestamp, level, message, source?, fields? }. Pass a new array when lines arrive

props.name: live
props.description: Controlled live state; paused freezes the view and counts buffered lines

props.name: initialLineId
props.description: Line to focus on mount; defaults to #log-<id> in the URL hash

props.name: onPermalink
props.description: Override permalink behaviour (default copies URL with #log-<id>)

usage: Feed it your log stream (WebSocket, SSE, polling) as an append-only array. Keyboard (focus inside): / search, j/k move, Enter expand JSON, f follow, space pause, g/G top/bottom, Esc clear. Alt+click a level chip to solo it; drag the histogram brush to narrow the time window. ANSI SGR colours are parsed by a small in-house parser (no approved library).
